comments.author: DatabaseConstant7870
comments.body: I use cursor, I pay $60 a month, it gives me access to opus 4.7, if I’m being honest composer 2.5 which is cursors own model seems to be working better. Their own model takes up less usage credits. Opus will ultra think stuff out if it’s a complicated task but if you know the steps to get what you’re needing you can go step by step with composer and get the same if not better results
